name: Campaign film
source: library: the luxury fragrance / fashion commercial register (think a sun-and-sea fragrance campaign), described generically
essence: A mood, not a pitch: slow, sensual, light-filled images that dissolve into one another, almost no words, ending on a still, perfect pack shot and the name.
why_it_works: It sells a feeling the viewer wants to step into
Restraint reads as confidence and price
The pack shot burns the product and name into memory

hook.pattern: no words at first; an arresting, atmospheric image of light, material or place
hook.first_frame: the most beautiful frame in the film

sound: cinematic: a slow piano or strings swell, or the sea; no voice
needs: a brand that sells desire or mood (fashion, fragrance, design, hospitality)
keep: two or three words in the whole film
the pack shot at the end
drop: any campaign's actors, locations, music or taglines
